sentences.japanese: いつかフランスに行くことは避けられない、それがいつかは分からないけれど。
sentences.english: It is inevitable that I go to France someday, I just don't know when.

sentences.japanese: 強大な権力を有する大国が存在する限り、戦争は避け難い。
sentences.english: As long as there are sovereign nations possessing great power, war is inevitable.

sentences.japanese: 危機の際にも冷静さを失わず、狂気に走るのを避けることが肝要である。
sentences.english: It is essential to keep calm in a time of crisis and avoid going haywire.

sentences.japanese: 簡単な実験をすれば、多くの誤りが避けられたであろう。
sentences.english: People could have avoided many mistakes by simple experiments.

sentences.japanese: 外相は、戦争は避けられないと言った。
sentences.english: The Foreign Minister said that war was inevitable.
